name: @scotthuang/agent-knock-knock
changelog: Recover settled native-thread Store authority through verified owner/process identity and a durable transfer journal without terminal input or replaying old callbacks. Preserve per-call agent configuration during recovery checks. Remove the generic 90-second text-submission relay deadline while retaining transport/acceptance deadlines, explicit timeouts and Host cancellation. Store writer protocol 11, action contract 33 and List projection v4 retain identity and approval boundaries. Coordinate Pi 0.1.0-poc.8 and DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.11 with exact core 0.16.0 pins on next.
